data.name: Ismaana
data.gender_notes: Ismaana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Ismah, meaning 'exemption' or 'favor'. Ismaana refers to the mother of the Prophet Ibrahim (AS), and symbolizes the deep love and protection a mother provides. The name Ismaana carries the meaning “Mother of the Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ismaana usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the special bond between a mother and her child.
data.etymology: Ismaana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ismaana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إسماء
in_arabic.meaning: اسماء تعني الاسماء الحسنة والجميلة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسماء هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الاسماء الحسنة والجميلة. وهو مشتق من اسماء الله الحسنى ويدل على جمال وروعة الاسماء في اللغة العربية. وقد ورد ذكر الاسماء في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها" (الأعراف: 180).

in_urdu.name: اسماء
in_urdu.meaning: اسماء کا مطلب خوبصورت اور اچھے ناموں سے ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسماء ایک علم مؤنث ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب خوبصورت اور اچھے ناموں سے ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا بڑا احترام ہے۔ اسماء کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ اعراف میں: "ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها" (الآية: 180).

in_hindi.name: इस्मा
in_hindi.meaning: इस्मा का अर्थ सुंदर और अच्छे नामों से है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्मा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ सुंदर और अच्छे नामों से है। यह नाम अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों से प्रेरित है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका बहुत सम्मान है। इस्मा का जिक्र कुरआन में भी हुआ है, जैसे कि सूरा अल-आराफ में: "उलिल्लाहिल अस्माऊ अल-हुसना फादउहू बिहा" (आयत: 180)।

in_pashto.name: اسماء
in_pashto.meaning: اسماء معنی یې ښکلي او ښې نومونه دي
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسماء د ښکلي او ښې نومونو معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د الله ښکلي نومونه په کې شامل دي. په افغانستان کې د مسلمانانو په دود کې د اسماء نوم ډیر احترام لري. د اسماء نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې په سوره اعراف کې: "ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها" (الآية: 180).

in_english.name: Ismaana
in_english.meaning: Ismaana means beautiful and good names
in_english.long_meaning: Ismaana is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies beautiful and good names, reflecting the attributes of Allah's most beautiful names. The name Ismaana has historical significance in Islamic tradition, as mentioned in the Quran: "And to Allah belong the most beautiful names, so call Him by them" (Quran 7:180). The name conveys spiritual meaning and cultural importance across Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ismaana holds significant importance in Islamic culture, representing the motherly figure, resilience, and strength. It is dedication to the mother of Prophet Ibrahim (AS), who, despite having advanced age and the hardships of traveling, continued to show immense patience and care for her family. This name signifies the essential role of mothers in nurturing and providing for their children, often inspiring principles of kindness, dedication, and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: Ismaana represents the importance of motherly love on a spiritual level. It underscores the unwavering divine favor and protection that surrounds the benevolent figures in Islamic history, particularly those who embody love, kindness, and strength, like mothers and prophets. The name Ismaana is also a reminder of Allah's endless grace and blessings, as we witness the manifestation of similar virtuous qualities exhibited by mothers for their children and the revered characters throughout Islamic history.
